entries.name: High Order Skyborne
racials: Read Leyline: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. If a leyline is nearby, you will become Attuned for the next 1 hour and the effect of this ability will be increased by 100%.
Walk on Air: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.
Elemental Insight: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
Wind Blessed: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.

Skysight: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 15% for 30 sec. If an elemental convergence is nearby, you will become Charged for the next 1 hour and the effect of this ability will be increased by 100%.

entries.name: Human
racials: Perception: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.
Ruthless: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%.
The Human Spirit: Spirit increased by 10%.
Will to Survive: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

entries.name: Orc
racials: Blood Fury: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.
Hardiness: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.
Shatter Curse: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.
Command: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.
Command: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.
Command: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

entries.name: Dwarf
racials: Find Treasure: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap and sometimes increase treasure found. Lasts until canceled.
Stoneform: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
Artisan's Precision: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.
Big Game Hunter: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

entries.name: Night Elf
racials: Shadowmeld: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.
Quickness: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.
Wisp Spirit: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.
Quickness Passive
Elune's Light: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Undead
racials: Underwater Breathing: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.
Will of the Forsaken: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

Cannibalize: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.
Touch of the Grave: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.
Touch of the Grave: Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

entries.name: Tauren
racials: War Stomp: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.
Endurance: Total Health increased by 5%.
Cultivation: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.
Plainsrunning: Gain 2% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 60% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect.

entries.name: Gnome
racials: Escape Artist: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.
Expansive Mind: Maximum Mana increased by 5%.
Engineering Specialization: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.
Expansive Mind: Maximum Energy increased by 5%.
Expansive Mind: Maximum Rage increased by 5%.
Eureka!: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.
Eureka!: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.
Eureka!: Your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage or healing for 8 sec.
Eureka!: Your damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.
Eureka!: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

entries.name: Troll
racials: Berserking: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.
Regeneration: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.
Beast Slaying: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
Rapid Regeneration: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.
